mapper.select: SELECT MENU_ID , NAME , PRICE , IS_AVAILABLE , CREATED_AT , UPDATED_AT , IS_USED , CATEGORY_ID , IMAGE_PATH FROM menu WHERE CATEGORY_ID = #{category}
SELECT MENU_ID , NAME , PRICE , IS_AVAILABLE , CREATED_AT , UPDATED_AT , IS_USED , CATEGORY_ID , IMAGE_PATH , DESCRIPTION FROM menu WHERE MENU_ID = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( USER_ID , STATUS , CREATED_TIME , UPDATED_TIME , IS_USED , AMOUNT) VALUES ( #{userId} ,'ORDERED' , NOW() , NOW() , 'Y' , #{amount})

mapper.select: SELECT m.NAME , oi.QUANTITY , m.PRICE FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN menu m ON oi.MENU_ID = m.MENU_ID WHERE oi.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
